title: 有機・バイオ機能化学
subtitle: Functional Chemistry of Bio and Organic Materials and Processes
keywords: Functions of organic compounds 2.Functions of polymers 3.Life phenomena 4.Environmentally friendly materials
educationalGoal: This class provides knowledge about the design of new materials for a sustainable society. After the class, you will understand the properties and functions of bio-productive materials, such as pigments, oils, enzymes, and polymers. In addition, you will also learn about organic polymers that mimic biological functions. In the second half of the class, several life phenomena (protein biosynthesis, cellular stress response, apoptosis, aging, regenerative medicine, and stem cells) are discussed with the function of the related biomolecules.
advice: This course will cover: 1. Functions of organic compounds a. Properties of pigments b. Properties of oils and fats 2. Functions and applications of polymers: a. Bio-mimetics b. Green and sustainable chemistry 3. Life phenomena a. Protein biosynthesis b. Cellular stress response c. Stem cells and Regenerative medicine d. Apoptosis and Aging e. Analytical methods for biomacromolecules
books: Textbooks:Let's Lean the Polymer-An Introduction to Polymer materials- (kagaku dojin), Fundamentals of Organic Chemistry Japanese 7th edition (Tokyo kagaku dojin) Reference books: Basics Biology (Yodosha)
requiredKnowledge: General knowledge of organic chemistry, biochemistry, applied biochemistry, and polymer chemistry are required. Review those concepts in the appropriate textbooks.

activityGoals.body: Explain properties and functions of organic compounds related to living things.
Explain properties and functions of polymers.
Explain several life phenomena with functions of the related biomolecules.
Explain properties of environmentally friendly materials by supplying examples.
